disclaimer: Iyi ishanduro yekuratidzira. Zvinangwa zvekurovedza muviri ndezvemuenzaniso uye hazvisati zvasimbiswa nemachiremba.
pain.title: Kubvunza nezvemarwadzo · {exercise}
pain.advice: Tinokurudzira kuti mutaure nachiremba wenyu musati marovedza muviri nhasi.
pain.red_flags: Pane kuzvimba, kufa ganzu kana marwadzo akapinza here?
home.offline_notice: Hatisi kusvika pasevha izvozvi. Munogona kuramba muchirovedza muviri — zvamunoita zvinochengetwa pafoni ino zvozotumirwa gare gare.
home.no_program: Hapana zvirovedzo zvamapihwa. Sarudzai chimwe pazvirovedzo zviri pazasi.
cg.title: Kubatsira murwere
cg.helping: Muri kubatsira {name} kurovedza muviri. Izwi richataura nemi, mubatsiri.
cg.setup1_body: Izendamisei pane chinhu chakasimba, kamera yakatarisa munhu.
cg.setup2_body: Munhu ari kurovedza muviri anomira kure nefoni.
cg.setup3_title: Onai kuti muviri wavo wose uri kuonekwa
cg.setup3_body: Kubva mumusoro kusvika kutsoka pachiratidziro. App ichakuudzai kana zvisina kudaro.
cg.no_program: Hapana zvirovedzo zvavakapihwa. Sarudzai chimwe pazvirovedzo zviri pazasi.
mirror.portrait_hint: Tendeutsai foni yenyu kurutivi kana kudzokera shure kuti muviri wenyu wose uonekwe.
hud.title: GIRAZI REKUPORA · AI
cam.privacy: Vhidhiyo yenyu inoramba iri pafoni ino. Mamaki ekurovedza chete ndiwo anotumirwa kuna chiremba wenyu.
cam.safety: Mirai kana mukanzwa marwadzo akapinza, dzungu kana kufa ganzu.
cam.safety_cg: Mirai kana vakanzwa marwadzo akapinza, dzungu kana kufa ganzu.
cam.stand_back: Mirai mamita 2–3 kubva pafoni kuti muviri wenyu wose uonekwe.
cam.stand_back_cg: Vamisei mamita 2–3 kubva pafoni kuti muviri wavo wose uonekwe.
cam.denied_body: RecoverLens inoda kamera kuti ione mafambiro enyu. Kuti muibvumire:
cam.denied_chrome: Chrome / Android: bayai kiyi kana chiratidzo chekamera panzvimbo yekero → Permissions → Camera → Allow.
cam.denied_safari: Safari / iPhone: bayai “aA” panzvimbo yekero → Website Settings → Camera → Allow.
cam.notfound_body: Batanidzai kamera, kana kuvhura RecoverLens pafoni, mozoedza zvakare.
cam.insecure_body: Mabhurawuza anobvumira kamera chete pamapeji e https:// (kana localhost). Shandisai link ye HTTPS.
cam.error_body: Vharai mamwe maapp angave achishandisa kamera, mozoedza zvakare.
sum.title: ZVAPERA
share.title: Kurovedza neRecoverLens
rec.torso_lean: Chengetai muviri wakatwasuka. Edzai kuita chirovedzo makamira musana wenyu uri pedyo nemadziro.
rec.asymmetry: Itai zvishoma nezvishoma kuti mativi ose afambe pamwe chete.
rec.back_arch: Simbisai mhasuru dzedumbu kuti musana urege kukombama.
rec.heel_rise: Chengetai zvitsitsinho pasi; zvirovedzo zvekutambanudza tsoka zvingabatsira.
rec.pelvis_drop: Chengetai chiuno chakaenzana; kusimbisa chiuno kungabatsira.
guided.explain: Kamera imwe chete haigoni kuyera kufamba uku zvakanaka, saka RecoverLens inokutungamirai nenguva.
sports.title: Kuongororwa kwevatambi
sports.intro: Kuongororwa kupfupi kwemafambiro. Zvinobuda zvinoonekwa kuti murairidzi kana chiremba azviongorore, hakusi kuongororwa kwechirwere.
sports.none_hint: Itai kuongororwa kuti muone zvabuda pano.
sport.running_blurb: Kukotamisa ibvi negumbo rimwe nekumira negumbo rimwe
screen.title: Bvunzo {i}/{n} · {label}
screen.note: Izvi zvinoonekwa nekamera, hakusi kuongororwa kwechirwere. Zvachengetedzwa.

obs.squat_valgus_right.bad: Ibvi rerudyi rakapinda mukati pakudzokorora {n} pa{total}

obs.sls_valgus_left.bad: Ibvi reruboshwe rakapinda mukati pakukotama {n} pa{total} negumbo rimwe
obs.sls_valgus_right.bad: Ibvi rerudyi rakapinda mukati pakukotama {n} pa{total} negumbo rimwe
obs.sls_pelvis_left.bad: Chiuno chakadonha pakukotama {n} pa{total} negumbo reruboshwe
obs.sls_pelvis_right.bad: Chiuno chakadonha pakukotama {n} pa{total} negumbo rerudyi
obs.landing_stiff.bad: Kudzika kwakaoma (mabvi akapotsa kutwasuka) pakusvetuka {n} pa{total}
obsrec.valgus: Funga nezvekusimbisa mhasuru dzechiuno nemagaro (semuenzaniso zvirovedzo zveFIFA 11+ zvekumira negumbo rimwe nekukotamisa mabvi).
obsrec.lean: Funga nezvezvirovedzo zvekufambisa tsoka nekusimbisa dumbu nemusana (semuenzaniso FIFA 11+ Bench/Sideways Bench).
obsrec.asymmetry: Funga nezvekuyera simba regumbo rimwe nerimwe nekudzidzira kumira negumbo rimwe (FIFA 11+ Single-Leg Stance).
obsrec.heel: Funga nezvezvirovedzo zvemakumbo nekutambanudza tsoka musati mapinda mukusvetuka.
obsrec.fifa_valgus: FIFA 11+: Squats (With Toe Raise → One-Leg Squats) neSingle-Leg Stance.
obsrec.fifa_landing: FIFA 11+: Jumping (Vertical Jumps), muchidzika zvinyoronyoro mabvi akatarisa zvigunwe.

alert.no_session_new: Hapana kurovedza kubva pavakawedzerwa mazuva {days} apfuura.
ex.shoulder_abduction.name: Kusimudza maoko kurutivi
ex.shoulder_abduction.desc: Simudzai maoko ose kurutivi kusvika pamapfudzi, muviri wakatwasuka.
ex.shoulder_abduction.step2: Simudzai maoko ose kurutivi kusvika pamapfudzi.
ex.shoulder_flexion.name: Kusimudza ruoko kumberi
ex.shoulder_flexion.desc: Mirai rutivi rwenyu rwakatarisa kamera, musimudze ruoko kumberi uye kumusoro musingakombamisi musana.
ex.shoulder_flexion.step1: Tendeukai rutivi rwenyu rwakatarisa kamera, ruoko ruri parutivi.
ex.shoulder_flexion.step2: Simudzai ruoko kumberi uye kumusoro sezvamunogona musingarwadziwi.
ex.shoulder_flexion.step3: Dzikisai zvishoma nezvishoma. Chengetai musana wakatwasuka.
ex.shoulder_external_rotation.name: Kutenderedza ruoko kunze
ex.shoulder_external_rotation.desc: Gokora rakanamatira parutivi uye rakakotama sekona, tenderedzai ruoko kunze.
ex.shoulder_external_rotation.step1: Namatidzai gokora parutivi rwenyu, rakakotama sekona.
ex.shoulder_internal_rotation.name: Kutenderedza ruoko kudumbu
ex.shoulder_internal_rotation.desc: Gokora rakanamatira parutivi uye rakakotama sekona, tenderedzai ruoko kudumbu.
ex.shoulder_internal_rotation.step1: Namatidzai gokora parutivi rwenyu, rakakotama sekona.
ex.pendulum_swing.name: Kutenderedza ruoko rwakarembera
ex.pendulum_swing.desc: Zendamirai patafura, ruoko rurembere rwakasununguka, ruchitenderera madenderedzwa madiki.
ex.pendulum_swing.step1: Kotamai kumberi, ruoko rwakanaka ruri patafura.
ex.mini_squat.name: Kukotamisa mabvi zvishoma
ex.mini_squat.desc: Tsoka dzakaparadzana kusvika pahupamhi hwechiuno, kotamisai mabvi zvishoma, mozosimuka.
ex.mini_squat.step1: Tarisai kamera, tsoka dzakaparadzana kusvika pahupamhi hwechiuno.
ex.sit_to_stand.name: Kusimuka pachigaro
ex.sit_to_stand.desc: Garai rutivi rwakatarisa kamera, mozosimuka zvakakwana uye kugara pasi makadzikama.
ex.sit_to_stand.step1: Isai chigaro chakasimba rutivi rwacho rwakatarisa kamera mogara pasi.
ex.sit_to_stand.step2: Simukai zvakakwana musingashandisi maoko kana muchigona.
ex.single_leg_balance.name: Kumira negumbo rimwe
ex.single_leg_balance.desc: Mirai negumbo rimwe kwemasekondi 30, chiuno chakaenzana.
ex.single_leg_balance.step1: Tarisai kamera, makamira pedyo nemadziro kana chigaro kuti mubatsirwe.
ex.quad_set.name: Kusimbisa chidya
ex.quad_set.desc: Tambanudzai ibvi musimbise chidya musingasimudzi gumbo.
ex.quad_set.step2: Tsikirirai shure kweibvi pasi musimbise chidya.
ex.straight_leg_raise.name: Kusimudza gumbo rakatwasuka
ex.straight_leg_raise.desc: Makarara pasi, chengetai ibvi rakatwasuka muchisimudza nekudzikisa zvishoma nezvishoma.
ex.straight_leg_raise.step2: Simbisai chidya musimudze gumbo rakatwasuka kusvika pakakwirira ibvi rimwe.
ex.heel_slide.name: Kukwevera chitsitsinho
ex.heel_slide.desc: Makarara pasi, kweverai chitsitsinho kwamuri kuti ibvi rikotame, mozotambanudza.
ex.step_up.name: Kukwira danho
ex.step_up.desc: Kwirai padanho rakaderera, muchitanga negumbo riri kupora.
ex.step_up.step2: Kwirai negumbo riri kupora, mozokwidza imwe tsoka.
ex.squat_screen.name: Bvunzo yekukotamisa mabvi
ex.squat_screen.step1: Tarisai kamera, tsoka dzakaparadzana kusvika pahupamhi hwemapfudzi, maoko kumberi.
ex.single_leg_squat.name: Kukotamisa ibvi negumbo rimwe
ex.single_leg_squat.desc: Kukotamisa ibvi zvishoma kashanu makamira negumbo rimwe.
ex.single_leg_squat.step2: Kotamisai ibvi ramamira naro zvishoma, rakatarisa zvigunwe.
ex.jump_landing.name: Kusvetuka nekudzika pasi
ex.jump_landing.desc: Kusvetuka kumusoro katatu, muchidzika zvinyoronyoro netsoka mbiri.
ex.jump_landing.step1: Tarisai kamera pane nzvimbo yakakwana makakupoteredzai.
ex.jump_landing.step3: Dzikai zvinyoronyoro mabvi akakotama. Itai katatu.

base.first: Kurovedza kwekutanga kwechirovedzo ichi kwanyorwa. Kuchava chiyero chenguva inotevera.
